data.question: What's the secret of air conditioning maintenance?
data.answer:
Some families think that they can use the air conditioner once and for all. They don't know how to maintain it, which affects the service life and the air quality of the home. In fact, air conditioning needs care and maintenance just like people. Proper maintenance of air conditioner can not only improve the efficiency and service life of air conditioner, but also reduce the failure rate and air pollution chance of air conditioner. The general maintenance methods are as follows:
1.1 Often clean the air filter screen: generally, clean it once every 2-3 weeks. The steps are: remove the panel - draw out the air filter - clean the air filter screen. Put the air filter screen in the tap water for washing. Since the filter screen is made of plastic frame fiber, it cannot be cleaned with hot water above 40 ℃ to prevent shrinkage and deformation. After cleaning, the water on the filter screen can be dried and inserted into the panel to install the air conditioner.
1.2 Protection of condenser and evaporator: the heat sink is made of 0.15 m aluminum sheet covered with copper tube and then expanded. It can not withstand collision. If the heat sink is damaged (inverted), the cooling effect of air conditioner will be affected and the refrigeration efficiency will be reduced. Therefore, special attention should be paid to the protection.
1.3 Protect the refrigeration system: if the components or connecting pipes of the refrigeration system are damaged, the refrigerant will leak out, and the air conditioner will not be able to cool or heat.
1.4 Correct selection of fusing (fuse): select the specification of fuse according to the rated current in the product manual. If it is too large, it will not work as a fuse, and if it is too small, it will be easy to fuse.
1.5 The operation time of remote control stop and start of air conditioner shall be more than 3 minutes, and continuous stop and start are not allowed.
1.6 Protect the electrical system from moisture. Electrical system is easy to leak electricity after being damped. So the electrical system parts must avoid water, especially in the rainy season, more attention should be paid to moisture.
1.7 Always check whether the power plug and socket are in good contact and whether they are loose or fall off.
1.8 Pay attention to the operation sound of the air conditioner. When you hear the abnormal noise of the air conditioner when it is running, such as metal collision sound, motor buzzing sound, shell vibration sound, etc., you should immediately shut down the machine to check the cause, and must not blindly continue to use, to avoid greater damage.
1.9 Wipe the exterior surface of the air conditioner, especially the panel part, to keep the air conditioner clean. Remove dust from outdoor cooler with long brush every six months.
1.10 When the air conditioner is not used for a long time, the battery of the remote controller should be taken to cut off the power supply of the air conditioner.

data.question: How to use air conditioner correctly?
data.answer:
2.1 When using the air conditioner for the first time, read the operation manual carefully and operate according to the method described above.
2.2 Set the appropriate temperature: generally set in the range of 26 ℃ - 27 ℃, which is more suitable for people's feelings, because now many
Air conditioning has the function of economic sleep, so it is better to start this function before going to bed to ensure that you will not feel too cold when you fall asleep and wake up.
2.3 Choose the right angle of the air outlet, try to avoid aiming at the human body, especially in the sleep of people directly blowing cold wind easy to get sick.
At present, the two-way scientific air supply function of air conditioner can solve this problem When hot, the angle is downward.
2.4  Use the timer effectively. When sleeping and going out, the timer can be used to make it run only in the necessary time, so as to save time
Save electricity.
2.5 Clean the air filter screen regularly. If the filter screen is blocked, the operation performance will be reduced, and the electricity charge will be increased. It should be cleaned once every half a month.
2.6 Don't let sunlight and hot air enter the room. When the air conditioner is open, it's better to use curtains or blinds to block the sunlight; at the same time, after opening the air conditioner, try to open less doors and windows to reduce the loss of cooling capacity and save electricity.
2.7 Do not block the indoor and outdoor air inlet and outlet, otherwise it will reduce the cooling and heating effect, waste of power, and seriously cause the air conditioner cannot work normally.
2.8 Only when it is necessary to turn on the air conditioner, it can not only make effective use of the air conditioner, but also save electricity.
2.9 When starting the machine, first turn the heating on the strong gear. If your air conditioner has no strong function, it is better to turn on the high wind gear. When the temperature is suitable, change the setting to medium or low gear to reduce energy consumption and noise.
2.10 The operation time of the air conditioner should be more than 3 minutes apart, and can not be stopped and opened continuously.
2.11 When the air conditioner is turned on, a certain amount of fresh air should be kept indoors, which can avoid people suffering from "air conditioning disease" in the air-conditioned room. If you The air conditioner has no air exchange function, so you can open a small gap between the doors and windows, so that the fresh air can naturally penetrate from the door and window seams.
2.12 When the indoor air conditioner is running, please do not insert your fingers or sticks into the air outlet because of the wind in the air conditioner If the fan rotates at high speed, it may cause injury accident.
2.13 The air conditioner should use a special power socket. Do not connect the power supply to the middle socket. Do not use the extension cord
Or share a socket with other electrical appliances, which may burn the power line, or even cause electric shock, heat or fire.
2.14 Do not damage or modify the power cord, which may cause electric shock, heat or fire.
2.15 Please switch on and off correctly according to the method described in the manual. Do not use the method of inserting or pulling out the power cord to start or pull out .Stop the operation of air conditioner, which may cause electric shock or fire accident.
2.16 When the air conditioner is not in use in season, in addition to cleaning the filter screen, professionals should also be invited to check the total heat exchanger and The cleaning of drainage equipment can not only eliminate the hidden danger of air-conditioning pollution, clean the air, but also make the air-conditioning performance radiant, Save electricity, save energy, prolong service life .
2.17 When the air conditioner is not used in season, the power plug should be pulled out and the battery in the remote control should be taken out to prevent accidental damage. After the indoor and outdoor units are cleaned and dried, the protective cover should be covered.
2.18 When the air conditioner is used again for the first time in the new season, the protective cover of the indoor unit should be removed first, and the shelter near the fuselage should be removed to confirm the power status of the battery in the remote control, and then the test run should be conducted to check whether the operation is normal.

data.question: How to use air conditioning more healthy?
data.answer:
3.1 Open the window regularly for 30 minutes in the morning and evening to maintain indoor air circulation (turn off the air conditioner when opening the window).
3.2 In winter and spring, the dehumidification function can be activated for 60 minutes every day to keep the indoor dry and cool. During heating, the air guide plate forms a thermal circulation downward,
The temperature can be adjusted quickly and evenly. When cooling, the air guide plate is horizontal, which can avoid the direct blowing of cold air.
3.3 When you fall asleep, press the sleep run key to avoid getting cold.
3.4 When there are old people and children at home, try to use soft wind operation.

data.question: How to use air conditioning to save energy?
data.answer:
4.1 Do not block the air outlet of indoor and outdoor units. It will affect the cooling / heating effect and cause waste
4.2 The connecting pipe of indoor and outdoor units of air conditioner shall be shortened as far as possible to improve the efficiency
4.3 When not in use for a long time, please pull out the plug
4.4 Avoid direct sunlight in the room
4.5 At night, you can use the sleep key or set the timing operation
4.6 It can reduce the heat exchange inside and outside the room, which is beneficial to save electricity and pay attention to the regulating room
It can save more than 10% in temperature, 1 ℃ higher in refrigeration and 2 ℃ lower in heating, but the difference is almost imperceptible to human body.

data.question: Why can't the air conditioner start immediately after it's shut down?
data.answer: Answer: after the air conditioner is shut down, it should be at least three minutes before it can be turned on again. Otherwise, liquid hammer will appear in the compressor, which will cause damage to parts and affect the service life of the compressor.

data.question: What have hung up and cabinet machines without plug? Why doesn't the manufacturer provide air switch?
data.answer: Generally speaking, the instantaneous current of the split machine or cabinet machine above 2p (including 2P) is very high when it is started, which is 2-3 times of the running current. The maximum current that the general air conditioning plug can bear is about 15a, while the general plug cannot bear such high current when starting. This will cause the power plug to burn for a long time, and more seriously, it will cause fire. In order to avoid such accidents, national security It is stipulated by the bureau that the rated current of air conditioner is above 16a, air conditioner manufacturer is not allowed to provide power plug, but air switch or knife switch must be used. In addition, because the air switch is a common household power distribution equipment, not within the scope of air conditioner production, so the manufacturer does not have a unified air switch.

data.question: Is the power line design of indoor air conditioner too short?
data.answer: Answer: the indoor power line of air conditioning is designed according to the actual situation of most consumers. The current design is reasonable.

data.question: When installing the air conditioner, if it is necessary to adjust the circuit and power supply, why should we ask a professional electrician to operate it?
data.answer: Answer: the power line adjustment must be carried out by professional technicians with electrician certificate. For your power safety, it is recommended to ask professional electricians to handle it.

data.question: The installation position of outdoor unit of air conditioner is higher than that of indoor unit, is it normal?
data.answer: Answer: it is normal that the drop between indoor and outdoor units is less than 5 meters when the installation position of outdoor unit is higher than or lower than that of indoor unit.

data.question: Why is the sound of outdoor unit running high and low?
data.answer: A: the change of the operating sound of the outdoor unit (variable speed machine) is caused by the change of the speed of the compressor controlled by the sensor of the air conditioning unit according to the change of the room temperature, which is a normal phenomenon.

data.question: During the first ten minutes when the air conditioner starts up, sometimes it makes a "split beat" sound. Is it normal?
data.answer: The shell material of the air conditioner is made of thin opal embossed plastic, which is light in weight and elegant in appearance. However, it will occur with the change of temperature and the physical phenomenon of thermal expansion and cold contraction. Therefore, the "split beat" sound of the air conditioner is caused by the small deformation of the shell, not a fault.

data.question: When the air conditioner is running, some products will occasionally produce "Hua Hua" sound, is it normal?
data.answer: A: during the operation of the air conditioner, the internal refrigerant state changes constantly, from liquid state to gas state, and then from gas state to liquid state. This normal physical phenomenon flows at a certain speed in the refrigeration system. Due to certain resistance, it will produce a kind of "Hua Hua" sound of flowing water, which is a normal phenomenon, especially in the dead of night.

data.question: What kind of "noise" is normal when the air conditioner works?
data.answer:
A. the wind noise of air conditioning operation can be improved by adjusting the corresponding wind speed.
B. The sound of "crackling" of thermal barrier and cold contraction of plastic parts of air conditioner can not be avoided completely. It can only be improved by adjusting the tightness or position of the shell.
C. The sound of rapid vaporization and liquefaction of refrigerant in the pipeline.

data.question: Some people think that the slight odor from the air conditioner is caused by the leakage of freon, right?
data.answer: A: actually, freon is odorless. The odor comes from indoor smoke and other odor. The new type air conditioner can not only remove the tiny dust particles, but also remove the odor of smoke and other peculiar smell by using the strong adsorption effect of the high-efficiency filter layer of activated carbon, which greatly improves the air purification.

data.question: If the indoor temperature can't be lowered, is there a fault with the air conditioner?
data.answer: A: you can first test whether the air outlet and outlet air temperature of the air conditioner are abnormal. If it is normal, it means that the air conditioner has no fault. The reasons why the indoor temperature can not fall down may be caused by too many people in the room, excessive heat dissipation, high outdoor temperature, room windows not closed tightly, curtains not tightened, heat source near the air conditioner, frequent door opening and closing, etc.

data.question: When the air conditioner is cooling, the ventilation of the indoor unit is not smooth (the wind speed is fast or slow), and the wind is not too cold. What is the reason for this?
data.answer: A: if the filter screen of the air conditioner is not cleaned in time, when the mesh is blocked, the ventilation will be blocked, the air volume will be reduced, and the cooling rate will be slow. It is recommended that users clean the filter screen at least once every two months.

data.question: Why has the air conditioner been on for half an hour and the indoor temperature has not reached the ideal effect?
data.answer: A: due to the floating of hot gas, the running time required to reach the set temperature during heating is longer than that during refrigeration. In addition, the heating effect is related to many factors, such as the size of the room area, the heat insulation performance of the room, the sealing performance of the door and window of the room, and the outdoor environmental temperature, etc. the change of these factors will also have a corresponding impact on the heating effect.

data.question: In heating mode, why is there no wind when it is just started?
data.answer: A: before sending hot air, in order to prevent the air conditioner from blowing out cold air, the anti cold air device needs to use the evaporator temperature detection circuit to detect the temperature of the evaporator. When the temperature is low, the indoor fan is forbidden to blow cold air. Only after the temperature rises can the hot air be blown.

data.question: In the heating process, why does the indoor unit stop air supply for a period of time and then turn on automatically after a few minutes?
data.answer: A: the air conditioner is defrosting. When the air conditioner has been running for a period of time, the outdoor condenser will have a very thick frost and snow. If the frost and snow can not be melted in time, the heating effect of the air conditioner will be directly affected. Therefore, when the air conditioning operation meets the defrosting conditions, the air conditioner will start to defrost. During the defrosting period, the indoor unit will stop blowing.

data.question: When the air conditioner is heating, why does the air outlet of the indoor unit smell plastic?
data.answer: A: when the new unit was just started for heating, the fan of the indoor unit did not work, and the temperature of the indoor unit was very high. It was normal for the plastic parts of the internal unit to have a slight plastic smell after high temperature. (the smell will disappear automatically after using for a period of time).

data.question: Why doesn't the outdoor unit drip water when air conditioning heating?
data.answer: Answer: the temperature and humidity of the outdoor unit are related to the temperature and humidity of the outdoor unit. For example: when the air conditioner is defrosting, the frost on the outdoor unit is very thin. When defrosting, the temperature of the evaporator is very high, and it is evaporated immediately, so there is no water dripping outside.

data.question: In winter, when users use the air conditioner, they find that there will be hot air and cold air. Why?
data.answer: A: check whether there is a problem with the setting of the remote control, whether it is set to "automatic mode", and set it to "heating mode". If the temperature is set higher, the problem can be solved.

data.question: Why does the whole machine have no reaction?
data.answer: A: please check whether there is power in the socket first (plug in the fan, light and other simple equipment for a try). If not, please check the power supply of your home. If there is power in the socket and the air conditioner power line is not damaged, it is the internal power circuit problem of the air conditioner, so you need to contact the local network for on-site maintenance.

data.question: How often does the air conditioner need fluorine?
data.answer: A: there is no fixed time for adding fluorine to the air conditioner. This is mainly based on the refrigeration effect of the air conditioner and the pressure in the air conditioning system. If these are normal, there is no need to add fluorine at all.
